headline_finding: Eleven video records across two subjects and two languages, produced in a single 8-day burst (19-27 Nov 2025, 10 of 11 records) followed by a 140-day silence and one further release (16 Apr 2026). Nine of eleven records teach one thesis: that a 7,000-year-old Sanskrit corpus (Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra) is executable computation. The remaining public record demonstrates a shipped real-time telemetry visualisation. The corpus supports strong claims about how the owner STRUCTURES an explanation and about what he chose to explain; it supports NO claim about how he SOUNDS or what he SAYS, because no transcript or caption text was retrievable for any of the 11.

evidence_ceiling.statement: This analysis is derived exclusively from titles, publish dates, durations, verbatim descriptions, playlist membership and channel About fields. It is a written-artefact analysis, not a spoken-content analysis.
evidence_ceiling.provenance: corpus-youtube.json · counts.videos_with_transcript_text = 0; videos[].transcript.value = 'not observable' for all 11; videos[].captions_available.value = 'not observable' for all 11
evidence_ceiling.upstream_reason: YouTube returned playabilityStatus=LOGIN_REQUIRED ('Sign in to confirm you are not a bot') for every watch request from this host, unauthenticated. No captionTracks were served, and the InnerTube get_transcript endpoint returned HTTP 400 failedPrecondition.

consequences.consequence: The conversational corpus extension (transcripts + summaries indexed for timestamp deep-linking) CANNOT be built from this evidence. The only timestamp index that exists in the corpus is the 7-chapter list the creator himself wrote into the description of p9pGAmqJCSk.
Framing must be drawn from description text, series architecture and cadence. Any on-site sentence describing what is said aloud in a video would be fabrication.

View counts WERE observable (channel.vanity_metrics_availability, videos[].vanity_metrics_availability) and are deliberately excluded from every ranking, cluster and depth signal in this document. Cluster membership is by subject, never by reach.

coverage_summary.reading: The channel strand is not a general corroborator of the CV. It supports exactly four capability rows and six of ten dimensions, and it contributes two technologies (Swift, Go) that no other dataset currently carries. Its real weight is on North Star Align and on the explanatory capacity that neither about.ts nor skills.ts currently has a row for.

content_dna_r117.model: A bipartite-plus graph. Content nodes are derived only from entities that appear literally in the corpus. Skill nodes and dimension nodes are the existing rows of skills.ts and about.ts, addressed by their verbatim join keys. Every edge carries a kind, a strength, the video ids that justify it, and - where the edge is weaker than it looks - the caveat that must travel with it into any rendering.

edge_kinds.demonstrates: A record shows the artefact of this capability running.
edge_kinds.explains: A record teaches the subject matter of this node.
edge_kinds.names-technology: A record names the technology the target row is about, in a different project.
edge_kinds.shares-subject: A record teaches the problem domain of the repository behind the target row, without evidencing the row's own claim.
edge_kinds.self-asserts: The claim comes from the owner's own channel About text, not from a record.
edge_kinds.extends: The corpus evidences something the target dataset does not currently claim.
edge_kinds.excluded: A superficially plausible edge that the evidence does not support; recorded so it is not drawn later by mistake.

notes: Node weight has two honest encodings in this dataset: record count and total runtime seconds. Never encode weight by view count (R-119).
Nine of eleven records sit under one tier-1 node. A force graph will collapse into one hub and one orphan; that asymmetry is the true shape and should be shown, not balanced away.
Every 'excluded' edge exists so a later renderer does not infer it. Excluded edges must not be drawn, but must survive in the dataset.

The unlisted record 9meaN-ZZAvc contributes to node weights in this analysis but MUST NOT be rendered, linked or named on the site (corpus_strand_risk.unlisted_handling). Any renderer must filter listing_status == 'Unlisted' before drawing.
